title: Basic Reading Skills
subject: English Language
objectives: Learn the correct sitting position for reading
Learn how to hold a book correctly

blocks.alt: A child sitting properly to read
blocks.caption: Sit upright when you read.

blocks.md: The sitting position for reading is as shown in the picture. Sit upright with your back straight.

While reading, move **only your eyes** and not your head.

The book is placed flat on the desk or held in the **LEFT palm** with your fingers placed on the book.

The book should be held about **10 centimetres** from the eyes.
**Remember:** Good reading posture protects your eyes and helps you read for a long time without getting tired.

quiz.q: What should you move while reading?
quiz.explain: You should move only your eyes, not your head.

quiz.q: How far should the book be from your eyes?
quiz.explain: Hold the book about 10 centimetres from your eyes.

quiz.q: Which hand should hold the book?
quiz.explain: The book is held in the LEFT palm.
